B9.adaptation: Independent paper-inspired adaptation; not an exact reproduction and no external code, prompts, examples, or data are included.
B9.method: Independent adaptation of ExIde-P5 executable grounding and global rule-dependency ideas under the CasePath output contract

shared_rules: Use only the observable claim packet and prior stage output supplied here.
Do not infer that an allegation is independently established.
Represent uncertainty with active_when, confidence, document state, or abstention.
Request a document only when it can support an explicit active fact needed by a decision.
Return only the JSON object requested by the response schema.

direct_draft.objective: Draft an end-to-end process and evidence plan directly from the observable packet.

direct_finalize.objective: Produce the final typed candidate artifact from the direct draft.
direct_finalize.ordering_constraint: Preserve only claims and requests justified by the observable packet.

document_draft.objective: Choose and classify potentially useful documents before constructing the process graph.
document_draft.ordering_constraint: List document choices first; do not draft decisions, facts, or process edges in this stage.

document_first_finalize.objective: Starting from the document-first draft, produce the final typed candidate artifact.
document_first_finalize.ordering_constraint: Keep the document-first ordering, then connect retained requests to decisions and facts.

process_draft.objective: Construct active process decisions, branches, terminal outcomes, and the facts each decision requires.
process_draft.ordering_constraint: Do not select or request documents in this stage.

evidence_from_process.objective: Produce the final typed candidate artifact by deriving evidence capabilities and minimum document requests from the process draft.
evidence_from_process.ordering_constraint: For each request, preserve an active decision to required fact to evidence capability to document chain.

exide_rule_draft.objective: Apply the paper-inspired ExIde-P5 idea: translate the observable packet into executable pseudo-code, then extract atomic condition/action rules.
exide_rule_draft.ordering_constraint: Return only pseudo-code and condition/action rules. Do not create CasePath fact, evidence-capability, document, decision-graph, or request structures in this stage.

exide_finalize.objective: Infer sequential, conditional, parallel, or unrelated dependencies among the executable rules, then map the observable packet and rule draft to the final typed candidate artifact.
exide_finalize.ordering_constraint: Use only the packet and rule draft. Preserve the generic executable-rule grounding before constructing the final CasePath representation.
